claim: The armed MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 auto-land route refuses every PR its own producer opens, because r4-demotion-gate.yml opens the PR with a PAT owned by benbaichmankass while clause A7 on the PR requires the author github-actions[bot].
evidence: r4-demotion-gate.yml: step 'Open the demotion PR' has GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN }} and runs `gh pr create`. docs/github-actions-workflows.md:1199 says BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN is a fine-grained PAT. mcp search_pull_requests 'repo:benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights is:pr head:automation/' -> #13158 (opened by .github/actions/commit-to-main action.yml:403 `gh pr create` with GH_TOKEN=inputs.token=BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN) user.login='benbaichmankass'; the same for #13150, #13143, #13142, #13141, #13140, #13133, #13132 (8/8). check_mandate_autoland.pr_author_login(<event {pull_request:{user:{login:'benbaichmankass'}}}>) -> ('benbaichmankass', 'from the GitHub event payload'); check_author then fails with 'A7 the PR was opened by 'benbaichmankass', not github-actions[bot]' (scripts/ci/check_mandate_autoland.py:606-609). The pre-flight run passes --pre-flight, which skips this read (lines 596-599), so the workflow reports ADMISSIBLE, enables auto-merge and pings 'lands itself on green'. Self-test fixtures all plant login github-actions[bot] (_event), so no test can fail on this.
expected: An operator-armed derisk_only cut that clears A1-A6/A8 merges on green with no human (mandates.yaml MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 arming note, 2026-09-27).
actual: On the first FIRE, guards (required, enforce_admins) goes red on R16/A7 and the cut does not merge; the real-money leg the mirror says is losing keeps trading until someone rewrites the declaration to hold and merges by hand, while the PR body and ping say it lands itself.
population: 1 armed mandate route; PR author identity measured over 8/8 most recent automation/* PRs opened with the same PAT (all benbaichmankass); 0 r4-demotion-gate FIREs to date (comms/mandate_firings/ absent), so not yet observed on a real fire.
detector: None exists. Proposed: a test that parses r4-demotion-gate.yml, finds the token used by `gh pr create`, and asserts it maps to the login A7 accepts (PAT -> owner login, github.token -> github-actions[bot]).
proposed_fix: Either accept the PAT owner in A7 only when paired with a provenance fact (the head branch was pushed by an r4-demotion-gate run, read from the Actions API), or open the PR with GITHUB_TOKEN and solve bot-PR CI separately.

claim: Nothing mechanical stops a session merging a Tier-2/3 PR declared `landing: hold`: it is green on every required check, and merge tools are pre-allowed.
evidence: curl -sS https://api.github.com/repos/benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights/branches/main -> protected=true, required_status_checks.contexts=['pytest-collect','pytest-run','guards'], enforcement_level='everyone'. pr-landing-guard runs inside `guards` (scripts/ci/run_guards.py:1336) and exits 0 on declared_hold (claude-pr-automerge.yml:67-73 records it; check_pr_landing.py hold branch ~1450 only fails on arming or a bad hold_reason). required_pull_request_reviews: null at last measurement (docs/audits/full-system-audit-2026-08-20.md:1394); the unauthenticated endpoint does not expose it, so it was not re-read today. .claude/settings.json permissions.allow includes 'mcp__github' (all its tools, merge_pull_request included) since #13138 (9980b87). The only merge hook matches mcp__github__merge_pull_request|enable_pr_auto_merge, and its own _comment records it is never invoked on Claude Code on the web. It also does not match the second GitHub MCP server in this session (mcp__2a2ac591-...__merge_pull_request).
expected: docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md 'Reading is never gated': approval exists for merging changes that affect live operations; CLAUDE.md tier table: Tier-3 merges only with explicit operator approval (or the data-backed standing authorization, with notification).
actual: The approval is enforced by prose alone. A held config/accounts.yaml or src/runtime/orders.py PR can be merged by any session through the MCP merge tool with green CI, and ict-git-sync pulls main to the live VM in about 5 minutes.
population: Branch protection on main (1 branch, measured live); .claude/settings.json at HEAD da9e68d; the pr-landing-guard hold path.
detector: None exists. Proposed: a push:main workflow that reads the merged PR's .github/pr-landing declaration and flags (pings, then files) any tier-2/3 `hold` merged with no approval record; a test plants one.
proposed_fix: Add that post-merge detector and an `ask` permission for merge_pull_request in settings.json; the operator decides on required reviews or CODEOWNERS for TIER3_PATHS.

claim: mandate_resolver._demote_s2 FIREs on a NaN net and on n_closed=1, so the auto-land A5 'independent replay' is weaker than the producer it re-checks.
evidence: Planted records in a scratch dir, called mr._demote_s2('x', root, ctx): {net: NaN, n_closed: 0} -> FIRE; {net: -0.01, n_closed: 1} -> FIRE; {net: 0.0, n_closed: 50} -> REFUSE R-EXPECTANCY. Code at scripts/ops/mandate_resolver.py:680-690 tests only isinstance(net, number) and `net >= 0` (False for NaN) and reads n_closed without checking it. The n>=20 floor lives only in the producer (r4_demotion_gate via R4 would_block, MIN_TRADES). check_mandate_autoland A3/A5 never recompute the record from source_run, and never check n.
expected: MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 `never:` forbids firing on a record that cannot be read ('we could not look'); the guard re-derives rather than trusting the producer (check_mandate_autoland docstring, A5).
actual: A NaN or single-trade record clears A5. Only A7 (workflow authorship) keeps such a record out today.
detector: A resolver test planting NaN, inf and n_closed < MIN_TRADES records, each expecting a REFUSE.
proposed_fix: In _demote_s2, refuse non-finite net (math.isfinite) and n_closed below R4's MIN_TRADES. Optionally have A3 recompute net and n from the committed source_run.
disposition: filed (this findings file; medium — no pipeline item required)

claim: src.units.ui.data_loaders.list_accounts reports an explicitly empty roster ([] = block all) as all 55 live strategies.
evidence: data_loaders.py:242 `"strategies": list(item.get("strategies", [])) or list_live_strategies()`. Ran list_accounts() at HEAD: bybit_2 -> 4 legs; ib_live -> 55 (turtle_soup, trend_donchian, fade_breakout_4h, ...); oanda_practice -> 55. config/accounts.yaml gives ib_live and oanda_practice `strategies: []`. Consumers: /api/diag account reads (src/web/api/routers/diag.py:2286, 2404). symbol_sets.py:213 names list_accounts as what feeds every /api/diag account read, and clients.py:1358/2039 pass that cfg to symbols_for_account_id(mode=UNION), which widens the cross-check symbol set to every strategy's symbols.
expected: CLAUDE.md 'A count that reads 0 may mean we could not look' and accounts/__init__.py:153-159: [] means explicitly empty (block all) and must stay distinct from None.
actual: The diag surface says a flat, dry_run real-money account (ib_live) routes 55 strategies. An emptied Stage-2 roster after a demotion would read the same.
population: 11 accounts in config/accounts.yaml; 2 with [] rosters are affected (ib_live, oanda_practice).
detector: scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py does not catch `or list_live_strategies()`. Proposed: a unit test that list_accounts() returns [] for an account declaring strategies: [].
proposed_fix: Preserve None vs []: `None if 'strategies' not in item else list(item.get('strategies') or [])`, and fall back to list_live_strategies() only on None.

claim: When r4_demotion_gate removes the last leg from a block-form roster it writes `strategies:` (null), and A2 then refuses the cut, so an emptying demotion can never auto-land.
evidence: remove_from_roster(accounts.yaml, 'alpaca_portfolio', ief_pullback_1d), then slv_pullback_1d -> yaml.safe_load gives strategies=None (key present). check_cut_only builds expected with [] (filtered list) and compares it with HEAD None, so they differ and A2 fails. The runtime loader reads null as [] (units/accounts/__init__.py:158-159), so trading is safe.
expected: CLAUDE.md: the operator decided that 'equality wins' when the last alpaca_live leg is demoted (the mirror empties with it), and the route is armed to land such cuts.
actual: Fails closed to a red guard (with auto-merge enabled) instead of landing. No money at risk.
population: Block-form rosters: alpaca_portfolio (2 legs). alpaca_live's form was not individually verified.
detector: A test that empties a block-form roster through remove_from_roster and runs check_cut_only.
proposed_fix: In remove_from_roster, write `strategies: []` when the last block item is removed.

claim: Confirmed: check_dry_run_in_diff.py passes a roster removal and fails `execution: shadow`. A roster removal is still Tier-3 by TIER3_PATHS and cannot SELF-land, so its only gap is finding hold-merge-unenforced.
evidence: Roster-cut diff (xrp_pullback_2h out of bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio, produced by r4_demotion_gate.remove_from_roster) -> `python3 scripts/check_dry_run_in_diff.py cut.diff` -> 'clean', rc=0. `+    execution: shadow` diff -> rc=1. check_pr_landing.py:421-423 lists config/accounts.yaml in TIER3_PATHS; R4 (tier 3 self), R5 (tier 1) and R15(g) (tier 2) each refuse self-landing it. check_roster_promotion_evidence.py:662 treats a removal as free by design.
expected: CLAUDE.md § two execution gates: 'removing a leg from an account's strategies: roster is not [guarded]'.
actual: True for the dry-run guard. The landing guard does cover it, down to the human-merge step, which is itself unenforced (see finding 2).
population: 2 planted diffs; 1 guard script; 3 landing rules.
proposed_fix: Doc-only: CLAUDE.md could add that the removal is caught by the tier floor (it cannot self-land) but not by any content guard.

claim: An auto-landed MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 cut cannot add exposure: it can only remove roster entries, exits keep managing any open position of the removed leg, sizing does not depend on roster length, and no traded symbol leaves the fetch/cross-check set today.
evidence: A2 reconstruction (check_mandate_autoland.py:268-292) plus self-test (24/24 held, `--self-test`), which includes the also_adds, other_key and stage1_cut plants. order_monitor.py:161-206: the exit population is UNION(open packages, roster), and line 175 says account-roster removal is harmless to exits. grep for roster-length sizing in src (len(strategies), share_of_roster) found no sizing use. Declared-symbol check: every leg on bybit_2, bybit_portfolio, alpaca_live and alpaca_portfolio has its symbol in `symbols:`, so UNION(roster, declared) is unchanged by any single cut. A2 also forbids editing `symbols:` in the same PR.
expected: The route 'can only ever remove; worst case less exposure' (docstring).
actual: Holds at HEAD. Latent: if a future Stage-2 leg trades a symbol that is not declared, cutting it drops that symbol from the naked-position cross-check while its position is still open.
population: 4 Stage-2 accounts, 13 roster entries; 271 tests passed across 12 landing/mandate/mirror test files.
detector: Existing: mandate-autoland self-test plus tests/test_paper_portfolio_accounts.py. Latent case: scripts/ci/check_roster_symbol_reachability.py reports undeclared roster symbols.
proposed_fix: None required. Optionally have A2 refuse a cut whose leg's symbol is roster-only.

claim: Three live docstrings and comments still say no mandate is armed, although MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 carries autoland: true.
evidence: r4-demotion-gate.yml header ('IT IS BUILT AND NOT ARMED ... NO entry carries it. So every run today falls back to landing: hold'); check_mandate_autoland.py docstring ('No entry in config/mandates.yaml carries it as this lands') and the A8 comment ('an UNARMED mandate — which is every mandate today'); config/mandates.yaml:84-87 cites `test_the_route_ships_unarmed ... asserts that no entry carries the field`, but that test no longer exists (tests/test_mandate_autoland.py has test_only_the_operator_armed_entry_is_armed at :167). The field: mandates.yaml:465 `autoland: true`.
expected: Field beats comment: prose matches config.
actual: Readers of the workflow are told a fire always waits for a human.
detector: Could extend test_only_the_operator_armed_entry_is_armed to grep the workflow header for the 'NOT ARMED' literal while any entry is armed.
proposed_fix: Update the three passages to say the route is armed, and when.
